entities.name: Germán Márquez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Germán Andres Márquez is a Venezuelan professional baseball pitcher for the San Diego Padres of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Colorado Rockies. He made his MLB debut in 2016. Márquez won a Silver Slugger Award in 2018 and was an All-Star in 2021.
